Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a program to allow youth to preregister to vote.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a program to allow youth to preregisterto vote; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary of state shall accept applications to register tovote from youth who are at least thirteen years of age and who meet allthe requirements to vote, except age. The names of the youthregistrants shall not be entered into the voter registration databaseuntil thirty days before an election in which they will be eligible tovote. Youth registrants shall receive all voter pamphlets and anadvisory ballot for statewide and federal elections. (2) The secretary of state shall adopt rules to implement thisprogram. (3) For the purposes of this section, an "advisory ballot" is aballot that contains all the statewide and federal races, as well asinitiatives, but which will be incapable of being counted.
